task: Turn a recording into an .srt subtitle file

x-display.title: Make subtitles from a recording
x-display.summary: Transcribe an audio or video recording into a timed SRT subtitle file.
x-display.description: Add captions to a recording or use the timed text as the starting point for editing subtitles. Open the SRT in your video editor or subtitle tool to review names, wording and timing before sharing it.

packaging_note: No upstream Docker packaging; pip install of the pinned commit with CPU torch and ffmpeg

access.why: Only the sample: it downloads whisper's own test recording at the pinned commit. Your recording never leaves the machine.

inputs.what: the recording; any format ffmpeg reads, whatever its extension

known_issues: The base model (139 MB) is baked into the image; pass --model_dir /models or it downloads again
First build takes about 15 minutes, mostly downloading torch
